src/Main.elm.message:
MODULE NAME MISMATCH - It looks like this module name is out of sync:

2| module Bar exposing (foo)
          #^^^#
I need it to match the file path, so I was expecting to see `Main` here. Make
the following change, and you should be all set!

    #Bar# -> #Main#

#Note#: I require that module names correspond to file paths. This makes it much
easier to explore unfamiliar codebases! So if you want to keep the current
module name, try renaming the file instead.
If you concatenate two lists, then you can merge them into one list.
If you concatenate two lists, but the first item is a single element list, then you should use the cons operator.
